rawFindings.title: Incorrect mountpath assignment in app.use for sub-applications
rawFindings.explanation: In app.use, when mounting an express sub-application, the new code assigns mount_app.mountpath = path. Previously it assigned mount_app.mountpath = mount_path, where mount_path was normalized to '/' when path was not a string. The change reintroduces the bug where mountpath is incorrectly set, especially for default mount path '/' when path is a function and mount_path was normalized to '/'.
rawFindings.suggestion: Replace the line `mount_app.mountpath = path;` with `mount_app.mountpath = mount_path;` to correctly assign the normalized mount path.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When calling app.use(fn) where fn is an express app, mount_app.mountpath is set to fn (function) instead of the normalized mount path string '/' causing downstream code relying on app.mountpath to fail or behave unexpectedly.
